title: Align tensor line to the current adopted Masterplan authority snapshot
finding: The canonical tensor experiment line still carried Masterplan Revision 8 / Version 1.3.0 and an amendment chain ending at Revision 8, while the repository's current adopted authority on main is Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0. Recent tensor evidence records already referenced Revision 11, so the branch-local authority bytes were stale relative to the authority cited by the packet evidence.
gardener_change: Selectively reuse the exact current-main Masterplan and amendment-chain blobs on exp/tensor-kernel-contract-01. No merge, rebase, branch creation, history rewrite, archive mutation, or semantic reinterpretation is performed; the authority files are copied byte-for-byte by blob identity so the tensor line reads the same adopted authority as main.

verification.method: Git blob identity and exact branch reread
verification.masterplan_header_reread: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / adopted / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
verification.reason_no_test_claim: The packet changes only authority documentation bytes; no code or test files changed and no workflow run exists on the exact alignment head.
